policy: Descriptors can prioritize DFPT labels but cannot promote a superconductivity claim without first-principles EPC and stability evidence.

features.name: H-active DOS geometric mean
features.limitation: Family-level correlation; does not encode EPC matrix elements, phonon scale, anharmonicity or stability.

features.name: phonon-assisted nesting
features.definition: P(omega), optionally normalized as P/(m* M)
features.cost: cheaper than full EPC in the proposed workflow
features.limitation: Small validation set; never map directly to Tc.

features.name: ensemble alpha2F surrogate
features.definition: predict alpha^2F(omega,P) with uncertainty and OOD score
features.cost: surrogate inference plus selected DFPT labels
features.limitation: Published BEE-NET is not directly hydride-ready; pressure/high-frequency extension must be validated.
